title: Exact high-order GPT cancellation in noncircular multilayers
summary: This paper is concerned with exact high-order generalized polarization tensor (GPT) cancellation in two-dimensional noncircular multilayers with finite positive isotropic coating conductivities. We first prove that, for every admissible cyclically symmetric core--shell geometry, there exists a unique positive coating conductivity for which the structure is weakly neutral to every uniform incident field.
